verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents core cap table management that updates automatically and smart-links to supporting documents in a secured data room (docs-7, docs-8, docs-35). Award agreements are tied to board consents, exercises, and stock certificates (docs-34), alongside option grants with vesting schedules (docs-2, docs-24), convertible notes (docs-21), and ASC 718 audit reporting (docs-3, docs-13). missing for 10: explicit SAFE support (only convertible notes are evidenced), explicit share-class management, documented investor/auditor access to the live cap table, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
